flows.name: habits-completion-write-v1
flows.description: Phase 2 (legacy, live until Phase 5 cutover #308): felix-admin-habits agent writes habit completions as `[Felix] YYYY-MM-DD | state | note` comments on Vikunja tasks. The cron continues to use this path until AGENTS.md is updated in Phase 5.

path.description: Step 4 helper parses [Felix] comments to determine already-addressed habits
Agent writes [Felix] YYYY-MM-DD | state comment to record completion

flows.name: habits-completion-write-v2
flows.description: Phase 3 (ADR-0002 Q3-D) canonical habit completion history. The new write path is built in #306; the felix-admin-habits agent begins calling it after Phase 5 cutover (#308). Both the v1 comment-write and this v2 JSONL-append remain documented until v1 is retired.

path.description: Three-write helper per ADR Q3-D: POST done=true, PUT [Felix] comment (mirror), state_log.append (canonical)
Calls state_log.append("habits", record) for the canonical JSONL write
Canonical per-domain JSONL history (Phase 2 substrate from mission shared-jsonl-state-log-library-01KS0E9A)

flows.name: habits-completion-read-v2
flows.description: Phase 3 (ADR-0002 Q3-D) canonical read path. `exclude_completed_v2.py` queries the JSONL state log to determine which habits are already complete for today, replacing the v1 LLM-driven comment parser. The agent begins using this read path after Phase 5 cutover (#308).

path.description: Vikunja-native filter expression for active-today habits, project-scoped to Habits
Calls state_log.read("habits", task_id, date, state="complete") per active task
Read-only scan of the canonical per-domain JSONL history

flows.name: habits-reconcile
flows.description: Phase 3 reconcile loop (FR-008, FR-009). Enumerates active habit tasks (project-scoped) and bridges Vikunja-UI completions to the JSONL log; reports drift in the opposite direction without auto-resolving.

path.description: Project-scoped enumeration of active habit tasks
Reads existing records to detect drift; appends backfill records with source=vikunja-ui
